text:
debrief db-021
1) The actor m-e-r-g-e-d the f-o-r-m-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y into a c-o-n-s-o-l-i-d-a-t-e-d p-e-r-s-o-n-a file and left a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t e-x-h-i-b-i-t on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-p-o-i-n-t.

2) The actor s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e d-raft as a c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-a-b-l-e and left the t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-a-g-e for c-o-n-t-e-n-t a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l.

3) The actor f-i-n-a-l-i-z-e-d the f-a-u-x c-o-n-v-e-r-s-a-t-i-o-n script as a r-e-c-o-r-d e-d a-s-s-e-t and left the c-h-a-r a-c-t-e-r b-i-o on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-t-h-i-c-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w of m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-o-n t-a-c-t-i-c-s.

4) The actor p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d the p-a-y-m-e-n-t e-x-t-r-a-c-t-i-o-n d-i-r-e-c-t-i-v-e-s as a p-l-a-n-n-e-d o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n and left the b-e-n-c-h-m-a-r-k d-a-t-a on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l s-c-r-e-e-n i-n-d-i-c-a-t-o-r.

5) The actor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d the d-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n m-e-t-h-o-d as a d-o-n-e i-t-e-m and left the c-o-v-e-r p-l-a-n on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-d-v-i-s-o-r c-o-n-s-u-l-t a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l.
